archetypes.name: dyn-tally-observability
archetypes.rationale: Checks that tolerated tally failures leave durable evidence without blocking Step 5.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the code-review tally flush path and self-review tally path. Focus on whether nonzero write-tally exits are captured in both tmpdir and run-root sidecars, whether execution-issues warnings point at the committed run-root path, and whether observability failures remain fail-open. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
